```{r, setup-file, include=FALSE}

# Set global chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,      # Show code chunks by default
  message = FALSE,  # Hide messages globally
  warning = FALSE,  # Hide warnings globally

  # fig.width = 8,    # Set default figure width

)

# Set global R options

# Load libraries----

pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ggpubr, parallel, mcprogress, pbapply)

  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # Remove major grid lines

## 1. Load Functions

```{r,, load-functions}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Source Functions ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
source("code/02_function_get_Peff.R")
# source("code/03_function_get_et0.R") # Used in case of weekly et0 data to convert to daily et0
source("code/04_function_get_kc.R")
source("code/05_function_get_budget.R")
quantile_df <- function(x, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)) {
    tibble(quantile = probs, value = quantile(x, probs, na.rm = TRUE))
}
```

### 3. A List of Crop Systems for Water Budgeting

```{r, crop-systems}
# The following are prepared with code:
# source("code/01_format_crop.system_kc_param_&_soil_param.R")
# and data files:
# 1. "data/raw/Model Crop Rotations Water budget Billikere_estimated rotations_effective rainfall.xlsx", sheet = "All rotations"
crop.system <- read.csv(file = "data/processed/crop.system.csv", header = TRUE)
knitr::kable(head(crop.system))
# This holds by row individual crop and parameters (irrigation) in a given crop system by row
crop.system.l <- read.csv(file = "data/processed/crop.system.l.csv", header = TRUE)
knitr::kable(head(crop.system.l))
```

### 4. Load Crop Parameters

```{r, load-crop}
#_________________
# Crop Parameters (rooting depth, kc by growing season) ----
#_________________
# The following are prepared with code:
# source("code/01_format_crop.system_kc_param_&_soil_param.R")
# and data files:
# 1. "data/raw/Model Crop Rotations Water budget Billikere_estimated rotations_effective rainfall.xlsx", sheet = "CROP parameter"
# 2. "data/raw/Kc Billikere final_mod.xlsx", sheet = "Crop cycles Kc"
crop.param <- read.csv(file = "data/processed/crop.parameters.csv", header = TRUE)
knitr::kable(head(crop.param))

root.crop.matches <- match(tolower(crop.system.l$crop), tolower(crop.param$crop))
if (!any(is.na(root.crop.matches))) {
  print("Crop root parameters present for crops in all rotations.")
}

# Add rooting depths for each crop in crop.systems
crop.system.l$rooting_depth_cm <- crop.param$rooting_depth_cm[
  match(tolower(crop.system.l$crop), tolower(crop.param$crop))]
# Save crop system data list for water budget function
crop.system.ls <- split(crop.system.l, crop.system.l$crop.system)
save(crop.system.ls, file = "data/processed/crop.system.ls.Rdata")

# This has data to produce Kc curves:
kc.doy.crops <- read.csv(file = "data/processed/Kc_curve_parameters_by_crop_rotation.csv", header = TRUE)
knitr::kable(head(kc.doy.crops[1:3,]))
# Are there parameteres present for all crop.rotations?
crop.rotation.all <- unique(crop.system.l$crop.rotation[crop.system.l$crop.rotation != "No_crop"])
kc.crop.matches <- match(tolower(crop.rotation.all), tolower(unique(kc.doy.crops$crop.rotation)))
if (!any(is.na(kc.crop.matches))) {
  print("Kc curve parameters present for crops in all rotations.")
}
```


```{r, kc-curves, plot-kc, fig.show="hold", out.width="50%", eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.cap='Kc curves for two sample crops.', include=TRUE}

kc.doy.ls <- split(kc.doy.crops, kc.doy.crops$crop.rotation)
kc.crops.ls <- lapply(kc.doy.ls, get_kc, from = as.Date("1922-01-01"), to = as.Date("1922-12-31"))

par(mar = c(4, 4, .1, .1))

if (!file.exists(all.kc.figure.file)) {
  pdf(all.kc.figure.file, width = 7, height = 5)
    invisible(lapply(names(kc.crops.ls), function(crop.rotation) {
  ls <- kc.crops.ls[[crop.rotation]]
    plot(1, type="n", xlab="DOY", ylab="kc", xlim=c(0, 366), ylim=c(0, (max(ls$clim$kc)*1.1)),
         main=paste0(toupper(crop.rotation), "\nSegmented Crop Coefficient Curve"))
    lines(x=ls$clim$doy, y=ls$clim$kc, type="l")
    segments(x0=ls$kc.key$doy, y0=0, x1=ls$kc.key$doy, y1=ls$kc.key$kc, cex=.5, col="blue", lty="dotted")
    points(x=ls$kc.key$doy, y=ls$kc.key$kc, cex=.5, col="blue")

    text(x=ls$actions$doy + c(-7, 7), y= 0.02, labels=ls$actions$actions, cex=0.8, col="magenta", srt=90, adj=0)
  }))
dev.off()
}
```

## 2. A List of Parameters & Input Data for Water Budget Function

```{r, set_param_budget, echo = TRUE}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Provide Input Parameters & data ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
p.list <- list(rain = rain,
               crop.param = crop.param,
               soil.param = soil.param,
               # et0.timestep = "weekly", # weekly/daily
               # et0.input = et0.week.imd, # For "weekly", choose: et0.week.imd
               et0.timestep = "daily", # weekly/daily
               et0.input = et0.daily, # For "daily", choose: et0.daily
               kc.doy.crops = kc.doy.crops,
               kc_no_crop = list(summer = 0.005, kr = 0.2),
               soil.type = "red",
               CN = 85,
               sm.init = 0.5)
met.forcing <- get_peff_et0(p = p.list)
```

## 3. Run Water Budget Function

Function is run in parallel for various crop systems

```{r, get_budget, eval = FALSE, include = TRUE}

# 1. Define the number of cores
num_cores <- detectCores() - 1

# 2. Create a cluster using the 'spawn' method (default for makeCluster, especially on Windows, or can be specified with 'type')
# The 'fork' method is the default on Linux/macOS and 'spawn' on Windows. 
# Running into errors using 'fork' method, for example with mclaply:
  # [UIFontDescriptor initialize] may have been in progress in another thread when fork() was called.

# Explicitly use "PSOCK" cluster type, which uses 'spawn' semantics across platforms.
cl <- makeCluster(num_cores, type = "PSOCK") 

# 3. Explicitly load the correct package on each node of the cluster. 
clusterEvalQ(cl, {library(tidyverse); library(ggpubr)})

# 4. Export necessary variables/packages to the cluster nodes
# When using 'spawn', child processes start fresh and don't inherit the parent's environment.
clusterExport(cl, varlist = c("p.list", "met.forcing", "get_budget", "get_kc", "quantile_df")) 

# 5. Use pblapply with the cluster object 'cl'
budget <- pblapply(crop.system.ls, get_budget, cl = cl, p = p.list, ts = met.forcing)

# 6. Stop the cluster when done
stopCluster(cl)
names(budget) <- names(crop.system.ls)
save(budget, file = "output/water_budgets/Budget.Rdata")

# For debugging:
# cs <- crop.system.ls[[9]]
# for (i in 1:length(crop.system.ls)) {
#   print(i)
#   budget <- lapply(crop.system.ls[i], get_budget, p = p.list, ts = met.forcing)
# }
```

## 4. Water Budgeting Outputs for various Crop Systems

### 1. Annual Climatology of Water Supply-Demand

```{r, plot-summary, echo = FALSE, fig.align = 'center', fig.cap = 'Annual Climatology of Water Supply Demand for various crop systems. Recharge is depicted in negative terms of the water consumption axis.', eval = TRUE, include = TRUE}

load(file = "output/water_budgets/Budget.Rdata")

crop.system <- read.csv(file = "data/processed/crop.system.csv", header = TRUE)

summary.yr.ls <- lapply(budget, function(x) {
    mean.yr <- x$sum.yr %>%
      pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "var", values_to = "value") %>%
      group_by(var) %>%
      summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(quantile = "mean")

    summary.yr <- x$summary.yr %>%
      mutate(quantile = as.character(quantile)) %>%
      bind_rows(mean.yr) %>% arrange(var)
  return(summary.yr)}
)

summary.crop <- dplyr::bind_rows(summary.yr.ls, .id = "crop.system") 
summary.crop <- summary.crop %>% 
  left_join(crop.system, by = "crop.system")

summ.qs <- summary.crop %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = quantile, values_from = value) %>%
  arrange(var, mean) %>%
  mutate(var.plot = forcats::fct_recode(factor(var), "Precipitation (mm)" = "P", "Precipitation - Recharge (mm)" = "Peff", "-Recharge (mm)" = "Q", "ET (mm)" = "aet", "Crop ET (mm)" = "aet.crop", "ET:Effective Rainfall" = "aet.to.Peff", "Crop ET Supply:Demand" = "aet.to.etc.crop", "NPWR (mm)" = "balance", "Potential ET (mm)" = "et0", "Potential Crop ET (mm)" = "etc", "etc.crop (mm)" = "etc.crop", "Potential Crop ET given Soil Moisture" = "etcs", "Irrigation (mm)" = "irrigation", "Recharge (mm)" = "recharge", "% Runoff" = "runoff.percent", "% Soil Moisture" = "sm.percent"))

# arrange factor levels in the order of 'Balance' 
summ.qs.balance <- summ.qs %>% subset(var %in% c("balance")) %>%
  arrange(mean) %>%
  mutate(crop.system = factor(crop.system, crop.system)) # this line reorders the factor in the same order
summ.qs$crop.system <- factor(summ.qs$crop.system,           levels=levels(summ.qs.balance$crop.system))

save(summ.qs, file = "output/water_budgets/summ.qs.Rdata")

# Plot Annual Climatology of Water Supply Demand & NPWR 
yr.vars.to.plot.1 <- c("Recharge (mm)", "Irrigation (mm)", "Crop ET Supply:Demand")
summ.qs.select.1 <- summ.qs %>% subset(var.plot %in% yr.vars.to.plot.1) %>%
    mutate(var.plot = factor(var.plot, levels = c("Irrigation (mm)", "Recharge (mm)", "Crop ET Supply:Demand")))
  
p.yr.budget <- ggplot(summ.qs.select.1,
       aes(y = crop.system, x = `0.5`)) +
  facet_grid(. ~ var.plot, scales = "free_x") +
  geom_col(aes(fill = Irrigation)) +
  xlab("Median (95 CI)") + ylab("Crop System") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmax = `0.975`, xmin = `0.025`), width = 0.1) +
  theme_baseR + theme(legend.title = element_blank())
# print(p.yr.budget)
ggsave(plot = p.yr.budget, file = paste0("figures/water_budgets/annual_crop.system_budget.jpg"), width = 9, height = 4)

p.yr.budget.mean <- ggplot(summ.qs.select.1,
       aes(y = crop.system, x = mean)) +
  facet_grid(. ~ var.plot, scales = "free_x") +
  geom_col(aes(fill = Irrigation)) +
  xlab("Mean (95 CI)") + ylab("Crop System") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmax = `0.975`, xmin = `0.025`), width = 0.1) +
  theme_baseR + theme(legend.title = element_blank())
print(p.yr.budget.mean)
ggsave(plot = p.yr.budget.mean, file = paste0("figures/water_budgets/annual_crop.system_budget_mean.jpg"), width = 9, height = 4)

```

### 3. Monthly Climatalogy of Water Budget

```{r, monthly-supply-demand, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.cap='Monthly climatalogy of water fluxes (median + 95 CI) for various crop systems. Note that recharge is depicted in negative terms on the water consumption axis. Crop systems are organised in order of increasing annual irrigation, followed by decreasing annual recharge.', include=TRUE}
# Plot monthly----
# When the functions in .fns return a data frame, you typically get a
  # "packed" data frame back

add_clim.mo <- function (x) {
  sum.mo <- x[["sum.mo"]] %>%
    mutate(plot.recharge = -recharge,
           plot.irri = if_else(irrigation == 0, NA, irrigation),
           plot.aet = if_else(aet == 0, NA, aet),
           plot.etc = if_else(etc == 0, NA, etc))
  
  clim.mo <- sum.mo %>%
  select(-year) %>%
  pivot_longer(-month, names_to = "var", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(var, month) %>%
  reframe(quantile_df(value)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "quantile", values_from = "value") %>%
  rename(q025 = `0.025`, q975 = `0.975`, median = `0.5`)
  x[["clim.mo"]] <- clim.mo
  return(x)
}
budget <- lapply(budget, add_clim.mo)
# Add crop system names
clim.mo.ls <- lapply(budget, function(x) {return(x$clim.mo)})
clim.crop <- dplyr::bind_rows(clim.mo.ls, .id = "crop.system") 
clim.crop <- clim.crop %>% 
  left_join(crop.system, by = "crop.system") %>% 
  select(crop.system, everything(), -rotation)

mo.vars.to.plot.1 <- c("plot.recharge", "plot.aet", "plot.etc", "plot.irri") 
                       
clim.crop.select.1 <- clim.crop %>% 
  subset(var %in% mo.vars.to.plot.1) %>%
  mutate(var_f = fct_recode(var, "Potential Crop ET" = "plot.etc",
                            "Actual ET" = "plot.aet", 
                            "-Recharge" = "plot.recharge",
                            #"Recharge" ="plot.recharge", 
                            "Irrigation" = "plot.irri"),
         var_f = factor(var_f, levels = c("Potential Crop ET",
                            "Actual ET", "-Recharge", "Irrigation"))) %>%
  # To order crop systems by least irrigation, joining total annual irrigation
  left_join(subset(clim.crop, var %in% "irrigation") %>% group_by(crop.system) %>% summarise(irri.median.sum = sum(median, na.rm = TRUE)), by = join_by(crop.system)) %>%
  left_join(subset(clim.crop, var %in% "recharge") %>% group_by(crop.system) %>% summarise(recharge.median.sum = sum(median, na.rm = TRUE)), by = join_by(crop.system)) %>%
  arrange(irri.median.sum, desc(recharge.median.sum)) %>%
  mutate(crop.system = fct_reorder(crop.system, 1:n()))

p.monthly.budget.base <- ggplot(clim.crop.select.1,
                            aes(x = month)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q025, ymax = q975, group = var_f, fill = var_f), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = median, group = var_f, color = var_f), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = as.character(1:12), limits = c(1, 12)) +
  theme_baseR +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 0, linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(crop.system ~ . , scales = "fixed")
p.monthly.budget <- p.monthly.budget.base +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank()) +
  ylab("Water Consumption (mm)") + xlab("Month") +
  ggtitle("Monthly Water Use & Recharge from Various Crop Systems in Billikere")
print(p.monthly.budget)
ggsave(plot = p.monthly.budget, file = paste0("figures/water_budgets/water_budget_monthly_select.1_crop.system.jpg"), width = 11.52 , height = 7.49)
```

### 4. Monthly Blue Water Potential of Various Crop Systems

```{r, mo-npwr, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.cap='Monthly climatalogy of NPWR (median + 95 CI) for various crop systems. Positive values are depicted in blue (Blue Water), negative values in red. Crop systems are organised in decreasing order of median annual Blue Water potential.', include=TRUE}

clim.crop.select.2 <- clim.crop %>%
  subset(var %in% "balance") %>%
  mutate(var_f = fct_recode(var, "NPWR" = "balance"), 
         crop.system = factor(crop.system, levels = levels(clim.crop.select.1$crop.system)))   

clim.crop.select.2 <- clim.crop.select.2 %>%
  left_join(clim.crop.select.2 %>% group_by(crop.system) %>% 
  summarise(balance.median.sum = sum(median, na.rm = TRUE)),  by = join_by(crop.system)) %>%
  arrange(desc(balance.median.sum))

p.monthly.npwr <- ggplot(mutate(clim.crop.select.2, above_axis = median >= 0),
                            aes(x = month)) +
  facet_wrap(crop.system ~ . , scales = "fixed") +
  # Ribbon for area below the horizontal axis (y=0)
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmin(q025, 0), ymax = 0, fill = "Below axis"), alpha = 0.5) +
  # Ribbon for area above the horizontal axis (y=0)
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = pmax(q975, 0), fill = "Above axis"), alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_baseR +
  # Manually define the colors for the fill aesthetic
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Below axis" = "lightpink", "Above axis" = "skyblue")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = median, color = above_axis, group = 1), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = as.character(1:12), limits = c(1, 12)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 0, linewidth = 0.2) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  ylab("NPWR (mm)") + xlab("Month") +
  ggtitle("Monthly Blue Water Potential for Various Crop Systems in Billikere")
print(p.monthly.npwr)
ggsave(plot = p.monthly.npwr, file = paste0("figures/water_budgets/water_budget_monthly_select.1_crop.system.jpg"), width = 11.52, height = 7.49)
